reason: Arithmetic check with exact official-matcher replays of the refined idea on 22 videos. Script: scratchpad rs/rs_check.py. It applies the ef_a3_rl_pr graph, and the control reproduces exactly (TP1113 FP82 FN70 on 05db0fb1). rs0 = linefit w0.8/win2 recomputed from raw ckpt coords on the final topology; rs2 = rs0 plus a fork split plus cuts at unscored edges. N_pred is identical, so the multiplier is 1.000. (1) The claimed ceiling rests on the wrong population. a_linefit is 353 FN, x ~7.8e-6 = +0.0027 at most. But the measured changes are mostly FP-side flips (05db0fb1 +2TP/-9FP, c73a1d11 +5/-12, 767a1e17 +9/-16), and they have both signs: 78a7bd97 -6/+8, 44b6_87bba6c4 -5/+6. (2) The unit is one FP removed or one FN->TP, which moves J_video by about 1/D, weighted by GT_video/sumGT. So a unit is about 1/73,054 on CONFIRMATION (71 44b6 videos, GT 19,826; 64 6bba videos, GT 53,228). The gate needs +146 units overall, +19.8 on 44b6 and +53 on 6bba. (3) 44b6: 5 of the 8 heavy-drop 44b6 videos (edge-filter dropped >= 700) are measured. Every changed one is NEGATIVE: 3a861e03 -3.8, 87bba6c4 -6.9, 2f31fc2f -2.9, 267148e4 -6.1 units. Sum -19.7 units (rs2: -14.2), which is about -0.001 on 44b6. So the per-embryo gate (+0.001) and the win-rate criterion (0/4 changed videos) both fail almost surely. (4) 6bba: 7 heavy videos sum +32 units (rs0) / +18 (rs2), with an SD of ~10 units per video. 5 random light videos show exactly 0. Extrapolated 6bba confirmation: +20..45 units, i.e. +0.0004..0.0008. Pooled confirmation: (+30 - 25)/73k, about +0.0001 (range -0.0003..+0.0006). Selection (6bba, GT 55.8k): about +0.0002..0.0004. Every case is 3-20x below the +0.002 gate. (5) The division term is negligible. rs1 (fork split) is byte-identical to rs0 on the heaviest video, and forks touch 0.14% of nodes. Local division TP 23/FP 43 means a single division flip is 0.1 x 1/194 = 5e-4, which is noise. The public 0.36 -> 0.40 claim has no mechanism behind it. (6) The per-axis / per-video-noise RTS of the original hypothesis was already undercut by the research: measured r/q anisotropy is ~1.08, and MMSE q/r under-smooths relative to the B28 optimum. So the arithmetic ceiling is about +0.0025, but the realistic captured fraction is ~0-20%. It is sign-unstable across embryos, with 44b6 negative.
fix_if_any: No repair reaches the gate. The only positive signal is in dense 6bba videos with many dropped relink edges and FP >= 80. A GT-free gate such as 're-smooth only where the node's shipped linefit window crossed an edge the edge filter later dropped' is almost what rs0 already does, so it will not flip the 44b6 sign. Cheapest salvage: fold rs0 as one zero-knob row into the x138 float-coordinate re-tune. That port changes coordinates and invalidates the w0.8 optimum anyway, and it must re-fit the smoothing kernel on the final (post-edgefilter/stitch) topology. Adopt it only if it passes the per-embryo gate there. Do not spend an LB probe or Kaggle GPU on it.
realistic_public_gain: About 0 (range -0.0005..+0.0005). If the public embryo behaves like 6bba, maybe +0.0003; if like 44b6, about -0.001. The division contribution is about 0. It is not a lever toward 0.97.
